traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Vahliaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; blades linear, lanceolate or ovate; stipules absent; leaf rosettes none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5; carpels 2 to 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
